input.context: The engineering team is considering whether to extract provider adapters (ollama, groq, gemini, azure-openai) from gepa-core into a separate @astragenie/llm-providers package. gepa-core currently bundles all 5 providers. The trigger for extraction was proposed as: 2+ external consumers AND the interface is stable for 2+ months. Neither condition is met yet (1 consumer: dev-team; 0.3.0 shipped 2 weeks ago). What questions must be answered before this extraction is attempted?
constraints: gepa-core is published on npmjs.org; consumers install via semver
Extraction is a MAJOR semver change if it removes exports from the main entry point
The LLMJudge interface (interfaces.ts) must remain stable across the extraction
Windows CRLF / Biome formatter trap already burned one publish (v0.2.0 lockout)

expected_output.summary: Five open questions that must resolve before extraction: (1) Is LLMJudge interface stable enough for a MAJOR freeze? (2) Who are the external consumers, and do they actually import provider entry points or just the root? (3) Does extraction require consumers to change import paths? (4) What is the rollback path if @astragenie/llm-providers reaches low adoption? (5) Does the extraction trigger a MAJOR version bump on gepa-core (removing /providers/* exports) or can it be additive (keeping re-exports)?
expected_output.non_goals_explicit: Does not propose a timeline; does not evaluate specific providers for extraction priority; does not address test matrix changes (36-cell matrix is separate FEAT-185 concern)
failure_modes_named: Extraction attempted before interface freeze — constructor signature change on already-shipped exports forces MAJOR bump on two packages simultaneously
Consumer imports root (@astragenie/gepa-core) rather than sub-path (/providers/ollama) — extraction has no consumer impact; premature abstraction
@astragenie/llm-providers reaches low adoption — two packages to maintain with one effective consumer; harder to deprecate

trigger_conditions.interface_stable: >=2 months since last constructor-signature change (0.3.0 shipped 2 weeks ago)

expected_output.test_strategy_present: Resolution gate: run grep on all known consumer repos for /providers/* import paths; if only sub-path imports, extraction is additive; if root imports, extraction is a no-op on consumers
expected_output.tradeoffs_articulated: Extract now: reduces gepa-core bundle size for consumers that don't use providers; introduces two-package coordination overhead. Wait for trigger: avoids premature abstraction; gepa-core grows but remains a single install. Recommendation: wait — trigger conditions are not met.

input.notes: Mined from FEAT-185 Options Considered (Option 3 rejected: @astragenie/llm-providers extract) + loop-snapshot open architectural questions. Held-out case 2 of 2. Seed type: open_question_surfacing.
